name: Daily Reminders — Small and Often
description:
**Not a session.** These are the things that work because they happen five times a day for one minute, not once a day for five minutes.

Sprinkle them through the day — between meetings, waiting for water to boil, on the floor with the baby. **There is no set, no round, and no finishing.**

This block is linked at the top of every workout so it stays visible, but it is deliberately not part of any session.

anytime.label: Daily Reminders
anytime.note: Small and often — squat, balance, ankle work. Not part of the session.

sets.name: ☀️ Through the Day — Small and Often
sets.notes: Once an hour if you can, whatever you can. **Missing them is not a failure and doing one of them is not a half-effort** — frequency is the entire mechanism here.

exercises.notes: Once an hour if you can. Heels down, easy breathing, a little deeper each time.
30s each foot. Let the **ankle** do the correcting, not the hip. Fingertip on a wall is fine on no sleep.
Heel glued down, knee over the toes. **No measurement right now** — the baseline is banked (right 1.5 fists, left 1 fist) and the re-measure is a few weeks out. Just do the reps.
Sole turns **outward** against the band, shin still. The left one is the point.

tips: Frequency is the mechanism. One minute five times beats five minutes once.
No sets, no rounds, no finishing.
The ankle work is for the left one specifically.
Missing a day costs nothing. Skipping a month costs the baseline.
